entities.summary: Javad Davari is the President of Islamic Republic of Iran Basketball Federation since February 2022. He is former Iranian professional basketball player, played as a point guard for Chemidor in the Iranian Basketball Super League. He was also a member of the Iranian national basketball team and competed at the 2008 Olympic Basketball Tournament. Davari previously played for Zob Ahan before joining Petrochimi.
